tools.name: clipwright_list_programs
tools.description: List the opt-in clipper programmes Clipwright can legally clip for (the rights holder grants the licence in the campaign brief).

tools.name: clipwright_check_rights
tools.description: Ask the rights gate whether a source may be clipped. Returns ALLOW or REFUSE with the reason. Deny-by-default.

tools.name: clipwright_register_grant
tools.description: Register a rights grant: kind is one of owned | program_brief | licence_file | open_licence. Verified by execution at registration. Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: clipwright_create_clips
tools.description: Create vertical 9:16 captioned clips from a source. Refuses with 403 unless a rights grant covers the source. Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: clipwright_job_status
tools.description: Fetch a clip job's status and rendered clips.

tools.name: clipwright_schedule
tools.description: Record a publish intent for the Empire Distributor. Publishes nothing (no platform token exists); returns publish_state NOT_PUBLISHED. Requires confirm=true.

tools.name: clipwright_tiktok_post_draft
tools.description: F6015/S3: DRAFT ONLY. Returns the same creator_info (nickname, privacy options, interaction/duration limits) a human sees on the compliant per-post TikTok screen. tools.name: clipwright_get_usage
tools.description: Read this key's plan, monthly source-video usage against the limit, and metered call counts.

tools.name: clipwright_export_data
tools.description: Export everything stored for this key (jobs with clip metadata, rights grants, schedule intents) as JSON.
